_tuning_notes: Nile crocodile in swamps. Neutral on land, ambush predator in water: lunge_range is the scan radius in blocks, grab_ticks the drag duration (40 = 2s with two chews at half attack each). Not tamable, not breedable (no items set). Phase 3: diet.hunts doubles as cage-trap bait (item form of the prey). RARITY: tier 'uncommon' supplies the spawn weight; group_size and nearby_cap are pinned here (1-2, cap 4). nearby_cap denies natural spawns when that many of this animal are already within 64 blocks — the fix for persistent CREATURE mobs accumulating forever.
guide_blurb: The river is its dinner table. Stay off the tablecloth.
